reviews.review:
I really enjoyed it! It deserved the hate on the first year of released, but compared with some of AAA games that's been dropped in 2025, Mass Effect Andromeda really showed what is the real open world Sci-Fi game should feels like.

I know the franchise won't be continue the Andromeda series, but if there is an opportunity for another one. I think they will make it right once Mass Effect 4 released and hopefully it is way better than the Trilogy and Andromeda.

7.8/10 
Pros:
- Overextended gameplay
- Lots of side-missions
- Interesting characters (especially Unc Drack)
- Wide-range maps to explore
- Not to serious protagonist (Shepard is badass, but too serious; Ryder is unmatured, but charismatic)

Cons:
- WTF WITH THE FACIAL APPEARANCES (especially the Asari) (Defo need mods to play this game)
- Not too much Renegade option (I just missed Shepard being an ahhhole with such an interesting dialogue we'll get to hear)
- No customization for squad's arsenals and option to utilize their abilities just like the ME Trilogy
- "The Less I Know, The Better" Storyline (It's just too cliffhanger and too bad we won't get the answer because the series is OVER)
- F*** THE UNPLAYABLE MULTIPLAYER

I couldn't recall why the game was received so luke-warm, bar the animation bugs... but man the dialogue writing is... scuffed? VAs are good, just the actual lines are...uhhh doing the tell don't show thing 

Gameplay is good enough, not as smooth as ME3, which was a bit more tight, yes to the jump/hover and talents and no to the enemies - which are just damage sponges, since the AI is too dumb to path the more complex open world

Its better than veilguard, but that's not saying much.
Different ot the original trilogy, but that's the point
It is a good addition, it's been a few years, might replay. The original trilogy, reply was never a question.
